info.title: Melted development API
info.description: First implemented reading slice of planned protocol v1. Not the frozen full v1 API. No ingest, model execution, preferences, plugin execution, full snapshot sync or third-party processing. List bodies/evidence are empty; fetch detail. Times are UTC RFC3339. Search is literal substring, not linguistic full-text search.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token; replay revokes the family
